purpose: Project-neutral projection and boundary application for mutable campaign policy.

projection.rule: Every campaign controller consumes a projection compiled from the current validated Global Policy State, not a caller-supplied model or mode label.

reconciliation.rule: An approved amendment produces explicit rotations, invalidated question IDs, recompile targets, and next role assignments at its declared effective boundary.

safety: an amendment cannot take effect before its declared boundary
affected role sessions are marked for rotation
the projection and reconciliation are independently content-addressed
provider and model names remain outside the portable kernel
